facts.business: NCL Research & Financial Services Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in providing loans and advances.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter paragraphs highlight: 1) Balances of loans, advances, trade receivables/payables subject to confirmation/reconciliation. 2) Interest income not recognized on outstanding advances (Rs 2108.63 lakhs) and loans (Rs 1710.26 lakhs) due to lack of documentation on interest rates. 3) Retrospective recognition of provisioning on standard assets per RBI directions (Ind AS 8 prior period error). 4) Write-off of bad debts (Rs 235.71 lakhs). 5) Need for strengthening internal controls. 6) Year-end recognition of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) per Ind AS 109. 7) Identification of MSME vendors incomplete.

key_risks: Balances of loans, advances, trade receivables and payables subject to confirmation and reconciliation
Non-recognition of interest income on significant outstanding advances (Rs 21.09 cr) and loans (Rs 17.10 cr) due to missing documentation
Retrospective provisioning for standard assets indicating prior period non-compliance
Write-off of trade receivables (Rs 2.36 cr) indicating credit risk
Internal control design deficiencies requiring strengthening
